```plato

    //==
    // # PolygonWithHoles2D predicates

    // True when no edge of either ring meets an edge of the other.
    RingsAreDisjoint(a: Array<Point2D>, b: Array<Point2D>): Boolean
        => a.Count.Range.Any(i => b.Count.Range.Any(j =>
            SegmentsIntersect(a[i], a.AtModulo(i + 1), b[j], b.AtModulo(j + 1)))).Not;
```
